hakkinda.metaDescription: What ROTAGANYAN is, how it works, and why it's a transparent platform.
hakkinda.title: About
hakkinda.intro: ROTAGANYAN is a platform built to bring horse racing analysis onto a transparent, data-driven, and rational footing.
hakkinda.misyon: Unrealistic promises of winning, dream-selling automated schemes, or “sure-fire formulas” have no place in our world. Our mission is to take horse racing analysis out of the realm of games of chance or machine-dictated outcomes, and instead build a respectable knowledge ecosystem that raises racing enthusiasts' data literacy and empowers them to write their own story.
hakkinda.seffaflik1: Every analysis passes a 6-step checklist before publication.
hakkinda.seffaflik2: Every prediction's outcome is publicly archived after the race.
hakkinda.seffaflik3: Incorrect predictions become methodology updates, complete with post-mortem notes.
hakkinda.seffaflik4: Hit rates are published live on the Statistics page — the numbers are never altered.
hakkinda.seffaflik5: Races marked as Banko (top pick) are tracked with separate statistics.
hakkinda.yasal: ROTAGANYAN is purely an analytical information platform. It does not encourage betting, and its content does not constitute investment advice. Horse racing and betting activities in Turkey are conducted under a TJK license within the framework of Law No. 7258. Please consider your legal responsibilities before using the site. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results.

gizlilik.metaDescription: ROTAGANYAN's personal data processing and KVKK disclosure notice.
gizlilik.title: Privacy Policy & KVKK Disclosure Notice
gizlilik.s1: This website is operated by ROTAGANYAN as the data controller under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK). Contact:
gizlilik.s2i2: Hashed password (never stored in plain text)
gizlilik.s2i3: IP address, browser information, session token
gizlilik.s2i4: Payment confirmation (card details are held by Stripe, never stored on our site)
gizlilik.s4not: Other than the above, personal data is not shared with or sold to third parties.
gizlilik.s5i1: Account data: Until account deletion, plus statutory retention periods
gizlilik.s5i3: Session tokens: Until logout or expiration
gizlilik.s5i4: Payment records: 10 years, per accounting regulations
gizlilik.s6p1: Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your personal data is being processed, request information if it is, learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly, learn about domestic/international transfers, request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data, request deletion or destruction, object to processing, and seek compensation for damages.
gizlilik.s6p2Pre: You can send your requests to
gizlilik.s6p2Post: You will receive a response within 30 days.
gizlilik.s7: Only essential session cookies are used. There are no analytics or marketing cookies. You can remove them by logging out or clearing your browser.
gizlilik.s8: This policy will be announced on the site whenever it is updated. Significant changes will be communicated to your registered email address.

programToolbar.comparisonDescription: Horses are not compared against each other; each is listed with its own past performance — this is for comparing how they've performed before under similar track/distance/hippodrome conditions to this race.
programToolbar.sonYarisDescription: KGS: number of days from the horse's last start to this race. Equipment/weight/jockey change is compared with the horse's most recent TJK race, while Won/Best Time is compared with this year's history at this hippodrome + distance + track type.
programToolbar.startSorunuTitle: Per TJK's official 'Late Start' detection — Yes if the horse broke late 2+ times in its last 3+ results
programToolbar.yarisciVerisiYok: Runner data has not loaded yet.
programToolbar.kazananlarAriaLabel: Which racing style stands out in this race type
programToolbar.kazananlarYetersizVeri: Not enough data yet for this race type (at least 3 races required).
programToolbar.kazananlarGecmisYarisAciklama: — winners of {n} PAST races at the same hippodrome+track+exact distance rode this way:
programToolbar.kazananlarTaktikIpucu: Tactical tip: at this hippodrome+track+distance, {style}-style horses have historically won — even if no horse in today's field carries this label, it's a clue to how the race may unfold.
programToolbar.kazananlarTekYaris: No permanent rule can be drawn from a single race — this only shows a past tendency, not a guarantee.
programToolbar.yarisStiliAciklama1: A recurring behavioral tendency calculated from at least 3 races in the horse's Accurace (GPS/sectional timing) history. The percentage shows how many races displayed that behavior; the number in parentheses is the total sample size (n).
programToolbar.yarisStiliAciklama2: (n≤4) are based on little data — e.g. 33%, meaning 3 races were run in 3 different styles (i.e. no clear tendency at all). More races (n) means more reliable.
programToolbar.kacakAtDesc: Goes to the very front of the field early in the race.
programToolbar.onGrupArkasiDesc: Sits just behind the leading group early on, in the front percentile of the field.
programToolbar.beklemeGrubuDesc: Sits in the middle percentile of the field early on, waiting.
programToolbar.enGeriTakipDesc: Trails at the very back of the field early on, tracking from a distance.
programToolbar.azSayidaYarisaDayaniyor: Based on few races, low confidence
programToolbar.dsTitle: Chose to start from an outside gate by preference
programToolbar.gorselIndirildi: Image downloaded — you can attach it when sharing.
programToolbar.analiziGormekIcinUye: You must be a member to view the analysis.
programToolbar.kosuProgramiBulunamadi: No race program found for this date.
programToolbar.comparisonEmpty: None of the horses in this race ran on the same track/distance/hippodrome in 2026.
programToolbar.h2hLoading: Searching TJK history for shared races…
programToolbar.h2hEmpty: No shared past race found in the TJK history of the horses in this race.
programToolbar.agfTrendDesc: Each horse's odds-share movement from the first measurement of the day to now (absolute point difference — large relative jumps from a small starting share can be noise, not the main signal) — shows where the market's money is shifting.
programToolbar.agfTrendYetersizVeri: Not enough odds-share measurements yet — the trend becomes clearer as more daily readings accumulate.
programToolbar.hareketYok: No significant movement in this direction.
programToolbar.gurultuTitle: Possible noise from a small starting share
programToolbar.agfTrendKaynak: Source: odds-share measurements taken several times a day (agf-sync). ∅ = only one measurement so far, trend not yet computable.
programToolbar.sonHazirliklarNot: Only workouts from since the horse's last race are shown.
programToolbar.idmanJokeyiTitle: The training jockey ({jockey}) will also ride in the race — a positive factor
programToolbar.videoAitCalisma: Most recent workout this footage belongs to (TJK)

kullanimKosullari.metaDescription: ROTAGANYAN platform's terms of use and disclaimer.
kullanimKosullari.title: Terms of Use
kullanimKosullari.s1: ROTAGANYAN is a web platform providing horse racing analysis and statistical information. It offers users predictions, pedigree analysis, and methodology content. The platform is not a horse racing operator and does not act as a betting intermediary.
kullanimKosullari.s2i1: You must be over 18 years old to access the platform.
kullanimKosullari.s2i2: You agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information when creating an account.
kullanimKosullari.s2i3: You are responsible for your account's security; do not share your password.
kullanimKosullari.s2i4: Content scraping, automated access, or overloading the system is prohibited.
kullanimKosullari.s2i5: Content is protected by copyright; it may not be copied without attribution.
kullanimKosullari.s3p1: The analyses and predictions published on ROTAGANYAN do not constitute investment advice, financial recommendations, or betting guidance.
kullanimKosullari.s3p2: Past performance is not a guarantee of future results. Every horse race outcome depends on numerous variables, and precise prediction is not possible.
kullanimKosullari.s3p3: ROTAGANYAN cannot be held liable for any material or non-material damages arising from decisions users make based on information on the platform.
kullanimKosullari.s4: Horse racing and betting activities can only be legally conducted in the Republic of Turkey under Law No. 7258 and exclusively under a TJK license. Users are responsible for complying with the legal regulations applicable in their own country.
kullanimKosullari.s5i1: The premium subscription is billed monthly.
kullanimKosullari.s5i2: Cancellation requests must be made before the next billing period.
kullanimKosullari.s5i3: Fees paid for the current period are non-refundable.
kullanimKosullari.s5i4: No guarantee of content availability is made; the platform does not commit to uninterrupted service.
kullanimKosullari.s5i5: Payment and billing are processed through the Stripe infrastructure.
kullanimKosullari.s6: ROTAGANYAN may suspend or permanently close accounts that violate these terms without prior notice. Users may also delete their accounts at any time; in that case, personal data is removed within a reasonable period (see Privacy Policy).
kullanimKosullari.s7: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. The Istanbul Courts and Enforcement Offices have jurisdiction over any disputes.
